is:pr is:open author:demo-user.title: Add keyboard navigation to the command palette
is:pr is:open author:demo-user.body:
# Command palette shortcuts

Make the command palette usable without a mouse. Arrow keys move the selection without interrupting the search.

## Keyboard behavior

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ↑ / ↓ | Move between results |
| Enter | Run the selected command |
| Escape | Return to the search field |

- [x] Add keyboard navigation
- [ ] Test with VoiceOver

> [!NOTE]
> Existing shortcuts are unchanged.

is:issue is:open assignee:demo-user.body:
# Saved views

Make saved views easier to use without a mouse. Keep keyboard hints visible and preserve the current selection when results refresh.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Add visible shortcut hints
- [ ] Preserve selection on refresh
- [ ] Verify keyboard focus in dark mode

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ↑ / ↓ | Move selection |
| Enter | Open saved view |

> [!NOTE]
> Existing shortcuts should keep working.
